name: prioritized_borel_threshold_highest_even_frequently
lines: hf : ∀ (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ f n ∧ f n ≤ s
hstep : ∀ (n : ℕ), m (n + 1) = if m n < f n then f n else 0
hIrec : ∀ (N : ℕ), ∃ n ≥ N, f n = I
hmax : ∀ (n : ℕ), N0 ≤ n → f n ≤ I

steps.tactic: obtain ⟨I, hIpos, hIbound, hIrec, N0, hmax⟩ := prioritized_borel_highest_recurrent_index s f hf

exact
  ⟨I, hIpos, hIbound, hIrec, ⟨N0, hmax⟩,
    prioritized_borel_threshold_maximum_even_frequently f m I N0 hIpos hmax hIrec hstep⟩
